problems.problem: The requested plaque veil only partially executed: in the current poster the band behind logo (y130-147), title (y230-273) and subtitle (y344-361) still carries individually亮 dimple highlights (bright dents at the left of 'TOBACCO', between the two words, and right of 'VANILLE'), so cream serif strokes compete dent-by-dent with specular spots; the promised calm deep patina field reads only ~60% achieved versus the references' decisively quiet type zones.

The warm metallic bounce is still mis-aimed: the strongest dimple brightness sits along the right flank and lower-right corner (x~700-1000, y~900-1400) instead of pooling low-center beneath the bottle, so the light logic of the brief (bounce under the niche object) reads as side spill and pulls the eye off the centered plaque grid.

Contact detail crop [266,1185,815,1435] confirms a genuine zero-offset dark contact seam under the base (no floating), but the copper immediately beside and below the base keeps the same dimple value as the rest of the wall; there is no soft luminance pool or dimple-calming around the base, so grounding remains a thin line rather than an object sitting in light.

Plaque band steps are still near-equal (logo bottom 147 to title top 230 = 83px; title bottom 273 to subtitle top 344 = 71px; subtitle bottom 361 to rule 425 = 64px), so the three lines stack rhythmically instead of grouping logo+title against a stepped-down subtitle; the rule line at y425 also sits only ~48px above the cap top (461), crowning the cap rather than closing the band with air.

changes.value: Hand-hammered copper sheet wall, dense dimple texture; the upper forty percent fully smoothed into a calm deep amber-brown patina veil of very low contrast with no specular dents at all so engraved plaque type rests on a quiet even field; dimple highlights reappear only below mid-height and gradually brighten toward the bottom; one soft warm metallic bounce pool centered low directly beneath the middle of the frame, dimples calming and darkening within one bottle-width of that center pool; gentle darker vignette at side edges; no objects, no equipment, empty material and light only
